attributes.board_name: West Virginia Board of Social Work

rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 20 hours from programs pre-approved by a WV approved or certified provider (courses endorsed by ASWB, NASW, an approved WV provider, another state social work board or a CSWE-accredited program are recognized); balance via individual professional activities (self-directed study, writing, presentations, college courses, reading).
rules.audit_note: Licensees submit CE record forms (at least yearly is encouraged); keep records 3 years before renewal; the Board may ask for receipts/certificates. Agency policy training does not count.

topics.who: All licensees: mental health conditions of veterans and their families
Social work ethics (NASW Code of Ethics based)

rules.notes: 30 hours per two-year license period. Of the 20 approved-provider hours, at least 10 must be synchronous (in person or live online) and at most 10 asynchronous online. Renewal and CE due 30 days before expiry.
